matchupOfTheWeek.title: Run Defense vs. Rush Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Their unit actually grades better here (45th percentile vs. our 45th) — the closest thing to a swing spot working against us this week.

previewTake: Jacksonville's defense is genuinely elite — third in the NFL — which means this is going to be a grind, and frankly, their offense at ninth isn't exactly a pushover either. The one silver lining is that their rush defense and our rushing offense are basically identical twins in terms of grade (both 45th percentile), so if there's a place to attack them, it's probably there, though it's hardly a glaring weakness. They've been rolling lately at +0.52 EPA per play over their last three games, and that recent form is the kind of momentum that makes road games uncomfortable. The head-to-head history is delightfully chaotic — we've beaten them twice, they've beaten us twice since 2012 — but that 2024 loss was rough (32-16), a reminder of just how formidable they can be when firing on all cylinders.
